title: Moore Park Raceway
specs: Safety gear including helmet, gloves and closed toe shoes required for any on track activity
Proper racing attire mandatory for racing events
Karts require proper CIK or Speedway body work in good condition
Motorcycle gear: full race leathers strongly recommended; motocross gear allowed with hard elbows, knees, chest/back protector; back protector, gloves, boots covering ankle, full face helmet required
All race bikes must pass tech inspection; tech inspector can revoke approval or allow temporary fix

Motorcycle machine requirements: hand guards with sliders/bar end sliders and peg sliders required; oil and gas lines secure; water cooled machines use only water; kick/side stand removed or secured; throttle self closing; front and rear brakes in good condition; glass/plastic taped; tires street/slick type, no knobbies

services.desc: Non members new to Moore Park Raceway always welcome on race days as always. Please show up early for tech inspection if not already completed!(Non members with questions please message via facebook for the fastest

gap: Price for track use beyond membership fee not stated
blurb: Members have access to the race track for kart and motorcycle racing activities. Membership is family-based and requires passing a technical inspection of vehicles. Safety gear and proper racing attire are mandatory for on-track activities.
extraNote: Membership fee $250 per family, prorated for new members only; membership valid one year, renewable in March · New members on 6 month probation; membership can be revoked without refund for rule violations · No alcohol consumption during racing activities; alcohol ends track activity for the day · Belligerence, profanity, aggressive behavior results in removal and possible suspension · Members breaking alcohol rule face 1 year suspension with no refund · First offense of certain rules results in 3 month suspension and 1 year probation; second offense revokes membership with no refund
